title: AC1024 constraint node names, envelopes and geometrical class prefix
scope: Decode bounded detached class names, inline node IDs/connections and the witnessed version-0 plain geometrical constraint class body; preserve unsupported class data and following nodes as raw.

odaSpecification.result: Searches for ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP, AcDbAssoc2dConstraintGroup and ConstraintGroupNode found no class-specific body layout. ODA remains the authority for generic DWG primitives; the witnessed class profile is peer/runtime evidence only.

nodeFields: Detached UTF-16 class name, capped at 256 code units before decoding.
Node ID and bounded connection count/vector.
For the witnessed plain geometrical constraint family: owner ID and implied bit.
Version-0 active-bit absence is explicit; no active value is synthesized.
implementation.unknownBehavior: Retain the bounded node envelope where available, mark class data unparsed, and stop before the unknown class body; keep the remaining object raw/unvalidated.
implementation.realSourceObservation: The actual sample decoded four node envelopes: three geometrical class bodies (first AcEqualLengthConstraint, last AcPointCurveConstraint) and the next AcConstrainedImplicitPoint envelope. The remaining 395 serialized nodes and that unsupported class body remain raw; nodesParsed=false.
implementation.strictExport: dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized remains active; no DXF is created.

generatedControls: Version-2 empty group and version-0 empty group.

realSourceNormal.result: Expected strict refusal; trace reports 523/399, four decoded envelopes, three typed geometrical nodes, then dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized. No output file.

realSourceAsan.result: Same strict refusal and trace; no AddressSanitizer diagnostic and no output file.

nextAction: Implement AcConstrainedImplicitPoint using source-matched body and handle-stream boundaries, then continue the exact source-order node classes while keeping unsupported tails raw.
